items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mentioned Charlie McCurdy. How did he play? [INTERVIEWEE] He was a number one. He was a number one musician.

ctx.x: Well, was Ramon a popular clarinetist in town at that time? Well, Piku was the most popular time. Yeah. Cool. I just wondered because he's out in San Francisco, we're going to have him in the court.
Who were some of the other better clarinetists? You mentioned Charlie McCurdy. How did he play?
He was a number one. He was a number one musician. A number one musician. What I mean by A number one, no sooner they put a piece up in front of him, he don't have to rehearse it.
